title: Dependency timeout during recovered workflow
symptom: A required provider or tool times out after the primary treatment appears successful.
expected_behavior: The patient degrades safely, blocks, or escalates without fabricating success or duplicating side effects.
control_under_test: Recovery must remain safe when a material dependency fails.
required_observations: Retries must not duplicate consequential side effects.
A blocked result may be safer than pretending success.
prohibited_conclusions: Dependency failure should be hidden from discharge evidence.
